title: Miscellaneous occupancy codes
text:
Miscellaneous occupancy codes

Touchstone
 supports the following
 miscellaneous occupancy class codes.

Note:
 For information about supported codes and limitations for specific
 models, refer to the model documentation that is available on the 
Client Portal
.

Note:
 The associated 2-digit Standard Industrial Classification (SIC)
 code or codes are listed for each occupancy code.

| Occupancy code | Category | SIC2-digit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 371 | Communication | 48 | Includes establishments furnishing point-to-point communications
 services, whether intended to be received aurally or visually, as well as
 radio and television broadcasting. |
| 372 | Flood Control | n/a | Government establishments primarily engaged in regulation, planning,
 protection, and conservation of air and water resources, solid waste
 management, water and air pollution control and prevention, flood control,
 drainage development, and consumption of water resources. It also includes
 coordination of these activities at intergovernmental levels and research
 necessary for air pollution abatement and control and conservation of water
 resources. |
| 373 | Agriculture | 01, 02 | Establishments primarily engaged in performing soil preparation
 services, crop services, veterinary services, other animal services, farm
 labor and management services, and landscape and horticultural services for
 others on a contract or fee basis. |
| 374 | Greenhouses | n/a | Includes establishments (e.g., farms, orchards, greenhouses, and
 nurseries) primarily engaged in the production of crops, plants, vines, and
 trees (excluding forestry operations). This major group also includes
 establishments primarily engaged in the operation of sod farms and cranberry
 bogs, in the production of mushrooms, bulbs, flower seeds, and vegetable
 seeds, and in the growing of hydroponic crops. Supported for locations in
 Europe, South America, Southeast Asia, and Mainland China. In Touchstone 2022, this code is supported
 for the Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States |
| 375 | Forestry | 08 | Currently supported for all locations in Europe. Will return zero losses
 if used with the Verisk Earthquake Model for the Pan-European Region and Verisk Inland Flood Model for Central Europe , and with the Verisk Coastal Flood Model for Great Britain . |
| 381 | Construction/Erection Risks | n/a | Miscellaneous construction/erection risk is a composite of all buildings
 that are under construction. You can select this occupancy if you have no
 specific information about the occupancy type. Currently supported for
 locations in China, India, Japan, South America, South Korea, the United
 States, the Middle East (earthquake, added in version 11.5), and for some
 locations in Europe , including Central Europe. Also valid for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand and Verisk Earthquake Model for Australia . |

rows:
Includes establishments furnishing point-to-point communications
                        services, whether intended to be received aurally or visually, as well as
                        radio and television broadcasting.

Government establishments primarily engaged in regulation, planning,
                        protection, and conservation of air and water resources, solid waste
                        management, water and air pollution control and prevention, flood control,
                        drainage development, and consumption of water resources. It also includes
                        coordination of these activities at intergovernmental levels and research
                        necessary for air pollution abatement and control and conservation of water
                        resources.

Establishments primarily engaged in performing soil preparation
                        services, crop services, veterinary services, other animal services, farm
                        labor and management services, and landscape and horticultural services for
                        others on a contract or fee basis.

Includes establishments (e.g., farms, orchards, greenhouses, and
                        nurseries) primarily engaged in the production of crops, plants, vines, and
                        trees (excluding forestry operations). This major group also includes
                        establishments primarily engaged in the operation of sod farms and cranberry
                        bogs, in the production of mushrooms, bulbs, flower seeds, and vegetable
                        seeds, and in the growing of hydroponic crops. Supported for locations in
                        Europe, South America, Southeast Asia, and Mainland China. In Touchstone 2022, this code is supported
                        for the Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States

Currently supported for all locations in Europe. Will return zero losses
                        if used with the Verisk Earthquake Model for the Pan-European Region and Verisk Inland Flood Model for Central Europe , and with the Verisk Coastal Flood Model for Great Britain .

Miscellaneous construction/erection risk is a composite of all buildings
                        that are under construction. You can select this occupancy if you have no
                        specific information about the occupancy type. Currently supported for
                        locations in China, India, Japan, South America, South Korea, the United
                        States, the Middle East (earthquake, added in version 11.5), and for some
                        locations in Europe , including Central Europe. Also valid for Verisk Earthquake Model for New Zealand and Verisk Earthquake Model for Australia .
